newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb hits chamber of commerce in south Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Bomb hits chamber of commerce in south Corsica.

text.p: A bomb damaged offices of the chamber of commerce in the south Corsican town of Sartene on Saturday in what police suspected was a new attack by separatist guerrrillas on the French Mediterranean island.
There were no casualties and no one claimed responsibility for the blast, at 2.55 a.m. (0055 GMT).

The bomb battered offices of the chamber of commerce, headed by Gilbert Casanova, police said. Casanova also leads the Movement for Self-Determination, one of the rival political groups seeking more autonomy for Corsica.
Windows of neighbouring buildings were also blown out and two cars parked in the street were damaged.

Corsica has been shaken for the past two decades by a low-level guerrilla campaign. Prime Minister Alain Juppe won backing on Wednesday from Corsican deputies for a planned crackdown on separatist violence.
